summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of responsive design, dark mode toggle, and profile dropdown features. All 10 features tested and working correctly.
passed_tests: Dark mode toggle in header (desktop) - switches between light/dark themes correctly
Dark mode toggle in header (mobile) - works on mobile viewport
Dark mode persistence - uses localStorage key 'engitech-theme', persists across page refresh
Profile button shows avatar with user initial (A for Admin)
Profile dropdown shows name, email, role badge, bookmarks link, admin link, sign out
Mobile hamburger menu appears on screens < 768px
Mobile menu shows profile info (avatar, name, email, role) and nav links
Mobile menu shows Sign Out button
Landing page stats grid - 2x2 on mobile, 4 columns on desktop
Landing page branch cards - stack vertically on mobile, 2 columns on desktop
Equipment list cards - 1 column on mobile, 2 on tablet, 3 on desktop
Admin dashboard - card view on mobile, table view on desktop/tablet
Login/Register auth flow works in both light and dark mode
Equipment detail page section tabs scroll horizontally on mobile
Footer responsive layout - stacks on mobile, 3 columns on desktop
User dashboard bookmarks page responsive layout
critical_code_review_comments: All pages properly use CSS variable-based Tailwind classes (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card)
Dark mode correctly uses .dark class on <html> element
ThemeContext properly manages dark mode state with localStorage persistence
Header has proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Mobile breakpoint (md: 768px) correctly switches between hamburger and desktop nav
Admin dashboard correctly shows table on md+ screens and cards on mobile
context_for_next_testing_agent: All responsive design and dark mode features are working correctly. The app uses CSS variables for theming with .dark class on html element. Mobile breakpoint is md (768px). Profile dropdown on desktop, hamburger menu on mobile. Admin dashboard shows table on desktop, cards on mobile. All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing.
